snippet.title: Music World - Story Mode (normal)
snippet.description:
This is a full playthrough of the story mode of Music World on normal. Again, a few attempts were cut out. I am sorry for the static noise in the background.

00:00 Intro
00:28 World 1 Level 1 - Morning Dew
01:54 World 1 Level 2 - Picnic
03:29 World 1 Boss - Floweracula
05:09 World 2 Level 1 - Jungle Drum
06:44 World 2 Level 2 - Worship the World
08:15 World 2 Boss - Konga's Dance
10:05 World 3 Level 1 - Future City
11:49 World 3 Level 2 - Electrical Parade
13:18 World 3 Boss - Space Invader
15:07 Final Boss - Prince Shutter
16:48 Credits
17:13 Main Menu Showcase

The phone used in the video is the LG GT350.
